data.narrative:
eGenesis is a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Luhan Yang and George Church, having raised $250M+ to date. The valuation analysis relies on a peer universe of 3 same-sector, same-stage private comparables in Biotech & Health (Colossal Biosciences at $10.3B, Chai Discovery at $3.8B, and New Limit at $3.1B), supplemented by reference to 3 public biotech companies (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) with a median price-to-sales of 5.6x.

Two quantitative methods are applicable. Stage-Progression anchors to the $250M total raised as a baseline and applies a 1.7x step-up multiplier typical for Series C advancement, implying a $425M valuation. Peer-Median compares directly to the three same-stage private competitors, yielding a median of $3.8B (range: $3.1B–$10.3B). Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied, as eGenesis's revenue is not on file. The triangulated analysis across these two methods produces a range of $361M (low end derived from stage-progression anchoring) to $4.4B (high end reflecting peer dispersion), with a median of $2.1B. The wide range reflects material uncertainty around whether eGenesis tracks closer to the lower end of peer valuation or commands a premium within its cohort. Revenue visibility and clinical-stage progress will be critical to narrowing this band.
